guitar.evidence: Albert Hammond Jr.'s Epiphone Riviera and Nick Valensi's Stratocasters/Gibson ES models are reasonably documented from the early-2000s NYC rock revival era.

tone.target: bright jangly indie rock with clean/crunch blend

tone.summary: A bright, jangly signal chain utilizing a light boost/OD for edge, followed by an AC30-style amp model, subtle chorus modulation, and stereo delay for classic Strokes ambiance.
